coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Using the nine ground-truth variable entries as scoring units, two match fully (2/9 = 22%): target properties (p-logP, QED, binding affinity) and structural diversity, including long-carbon-chain occurrence. Feedback-versus-baseline comparisons provide only partial overlap with the required model configurations.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The design omits the fixed pipeline scripts and DeepSpeed configuration, substitutes EGFR/GSK-3β for ESR1/ACAA1, and does not specify the synthetic-versus-natural-product domain comparison or the required pretrained/feedback-finetuned/baseline configurations. It reports Top-10/Top-100 rather than Top-3 scores and omits the approximately 96.7% and 70.4% binding-affinity improvements. Much of the proposed experiment instead concerns additional distribution-alignment and reward-hacking analyses.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Missing all expected findings: MOLGEN's exceptionally high p-logP scores, maintained or improved QED, lower KD values with the specified ESR1/ACAA1 improvements, mitigation of molecular hallucinations, and maintained molecular diversity.
